reviews.title: These look and perform amazing
reviews.comment: I have a Lian Li case and AIO and decided to upgrade my case fans to the Lian Li Unifan SL Infinity fans for a finishing touch. What really pulled me in was the fact that the fans attach to each other which helps with having less cables to deal with and of course the way they look. The Lian Li L-Connect software is awesome and has so many lighting options to choose from as far as the colors, patterns, etc. They are a little pricey but well worth it in my opinion if you want quality fans that move a lot of air, are quiet, and look amazing.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: The best
reviews.comment: At this point, these fans are not only the best looking, but also one of the best functioning. Premium? Yep. Definitely over priced. But the aesthetic and performance they bring to your build is top tier. Easy to install, easy to configure with the L Connect software, and minimal wires. Daisy chain works great and the fans feel extremely premium. If you’re considering these fans for your build, just bite the bullet and buy them. Because let’s be honest…you’re going to anyway.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.title: Generally just really nice.
reviews.comment: At the time of writing this, Lian Li appears to be fantastic. I have a Lian Li case with Lian Li Fans on everything except my water cooler radiator. And I honestly kind of wish I had gotten a Lian Li watercooler instead, now. The way these connect all together in the same hub is just super convenient. Their software is also pretty good, especially now that it comes with OpenRGB directly. The RGB looks good, and I haven't had any issues with it glitching or anything (unlike my Kingston RAM RGBs)
reviews.author: CrunchityMunchity
